messages:
olivia: Afternoon team — quick sync for today's release train. We have three lanes: infra, runtime, api. Proposed start times: infra 17:30 UTC, runtime 18:00 UTC, api 18:30 UTC. Who's taking each slot? Reply with ack and any blockers.

dave: I can take infra (17:30). Need confirmation that the DB migration is behind a feature flag and a rollback script exists. @tiffany? :eyes:

tiffany: @dave yup — migration gated by `user_migration_v2` flag. Rollback script lives in the ops gist (link: https://gist.github.com/xxxx). I'll be on standby 17:15-18:15.

ajay: I'll own runtime (18:00). Can we do a 10m buffer after infra completes before starting runtime? Need to run warmup and KV-cache priming. Also will stagger cache clears: canary->global.

ci-bot: CI: infra/build #213 passed ✅  runtime/build #457 queued — no blockers flagged.

sam: Taking api (18:30). Note: api depends on runtime's public kv schema change — will only release after runtime at 50% canary. I'll run smoke checks and load test quicks.

olivia: Good. Rollback owners: infra -> dave, runtime -> ajay, api -> sam. Canary plan: 5% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100%. Support oncall (@support-oncall) has been notified. Please follow the smoke checklist and paste results in this thread. Reply with :thumbsup: when you ack your slot.

tiffany: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- curl /health -> 200
- auth flow (login, token refresh)
- sample generator latency <250ms
- DB read/write sanity on feature flag
- metrics: no 5xx spike
```
I'll run these after infra completes and post results.

dave: :thumbsup: I have the rollback commands ready and will post the runbook snippet just before 17:30. Expect infra done by 17:45 if no unexpected DB locks.

ajay: :thumbsup: will wait +10m buffer. I'll run warmup script `scripts/prime_kv.sh` and execute canary at 18:10.

sam: :thumbsup: will hold api until runtime confirms 50% canary healthy. Planning smoke + a quick end-to-end test at 18:45.

support-oncall: Noted — I'll escalate to the oncall channel if we hit rollback. I'll monitor SLOs and be ready to post incident if latency > 2x or error rate > 1%.

olivia: Thanks all. Quick reminders: 1) Post deploy marker in Release Dashboard, 2) add any post-deploy notes to the train ticket, 3) if anyone needs to swap slots ping here asap. See you in the thread with smoke results. :rocket:
